realReviews.author: Sam D
realReviews.text: I recently had some fencing work done by Gav.  From the get go, Gav was reliable, honest and eager to ensure customer satisfaction.  We are very happy with Gav's high quality workmanship.  We would recommend Gav to anyone searching for an honest quality driven tradesman, at a reasonable price.

realReviews.author: Gemma Pearce
realReviews.text: I would highly recommend Gav and Al! They provided excellent service and superior quality when building our timber fence. Very clear communication occurred from the initial meeting through to the finished product. Very reliable and great value for money. Will definitely be calling them again in the future!
